summary: Apollo IG Core Replacement, L.P. filed an 8-K reporting its net asset value (NAV) as of June 30, 2026, of $1,328.4 million, with investments at fair value of $1,852.2 million against $523.8 million in other liabilities. The filing contains no transaction, corporate action, or special situation; it is a routine periodic NAV disclosure by an investment fund. No offers, purchases, sales, restructurings, or strategic initiatives are described. The event is purely informational, providing financial data without any deal terms, parties, or board recommendations. Thus, it does not qualify as a special situation.
